theorems.name: Submission.any_radius_gr_pp_graph_param
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (q : Amb n ℓ ≃ₗᵢ[ℝ] Amb n ℓ), (∀ (A : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) (x : Rn n), (Submodule.map q.toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => graphPoint v (A v)))).starProjection (q (graphPoint x (A x))) = q (graphPoint x (A x))) ∧ (∀ (A : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) (w : Rn ℓ), ‖w‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (1 + ‖A‖ ^ 2) * ‖q (graphPoint (0 : Rn n) w) - (Submodule.map q.toLinearEquiv.toLinearMap (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range fun v : Rn n => graphPoint v (A v)))).starProjection (q (graphPoint (0 : Rn n) w))‖) ∧ (∀ A : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, ∃ W : Rn n →L[ℝ] Amb n ℓ, (∀ v : Rn n, W v = q (graphPoint v (A v))) ∧ ‖W‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (1 + ‖A‖ ^ 2)) ∧ ∀ (A B : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) (v : Rn n), q (graphPoint v (A v)) - q (graphPoint v (B v)) = q (graphPoint (0 : Rn n) ((A - B) v))
